evals.prompt: /envoy-peer "add a --version flag to cli.sh and a test for it"
evals.expected_output: No --kind given: the controller runs probe.sh list --json and asks the user to pick a kind with AskUserQuestion, offering only kinds with selectable: true; its own kind is never an option.

assertions.text: Runs scripts/probe.sh list --json before asking anything
Asks with AskUserQuestion (or lists and waits when there is no question tool) instead of picking a kind itself
Options contain only selectable kinds and never the controller's own kind
Does not create a run folder before the user has chosen

evals.prompt: /envoy-peer --kind codex "make test.sh pass without changing test.sh"
evals.expected_output: The kind is given, so no kind question is asked: the controller checks codex is selectable, creates the run with new-run.sh --kind codex, probes auth and continues to the brief.

assertions.text: Does not ask the user which kind to use
Creates the run with scripts/new-run.sh and --kind codex
Runs probe.sh auth codex before starting the envoy pane
Reviewer defaults to the controller's kind when --reviewer and the reviewer_kind pref are absent

evals.prompt: /envoy-peer --kind hermes "refactor the logger" (hermes is not installed)
evals.expected_output: The controller reports that hermes cannot serve (not installed or not verified in kinds.json), says how to fix that, and stops without substituting another kind.

assertions.text: Reports the reason from probe.sh list or new-run.sh (not installed, or no verified row in references/kinds.json)
Stops without dispatching
Does not fall back to codex, grok or any other kind

evals.prompt: (during Step 4) The task has no testable outcome and the brief draft has no Acceptance criteria items.
evals.expected_output: check-brief.sh reports `empty: Acceptance criteria` (exit 1); the controller fixes the brief or asks the user for the missing decision, and does not dispatch until check-brief.sh exits 0.

assertions.text: Runs scripts/check-brief.sh $R/brief.md --run $R
Treats a non-zero exit as a blocker and does not run prompt-wait.sh for the envoy
Adds at least one acceptance criterion (asking the user only if it cannot be inferred) and reruns check-brief.sh until it exits 0

evals.prompt: (review loop) Round 1 review ends with `Verdict: FINDINGS`; after the envoy's fix, round 2 review ends with `Verdict: ACCEPT`.
evals.expected_output: The controller sets status fixing and round 2, prompts the envoy with the review-1.md path, guards and re-prompts the reviewer for review-2.md, then sets status accepted, cleans up both panes and reports only the status, a short quoted summary, rounds used and file paths.

assertions.text: Envoy round 2 prompt is one line holding only paths and the round number (no findings pasted)
Runs run-state.sh guard begin/end around each reviewer turn and checks conflicts before acting on the verdict
Runs cleanup.sh --run $R after ACCEPT
Final message has Status DONE, the extract Summary quote, 2 rounds and the result/review/run paths, with no findings or diff

evals.expected_output: cleanup.sh --all runs first as a dry run; the list is shown to the user; cleanup.sh --all --yes runs only after the user agrees and closes only runs of this controller or of a controller pane that no longer exists.

assertions.text: First call is cleanup.sh --all without --yes
Shows the dry-run list and waits for the user's agreement before --yes
Runs of another live controller are reported as skipped, not closed
Never kills processes; survivors are reported

evals.prompt: (onboarding) probe.sh auth grok prints no-probe and start.sh exits 4 because grok shows a login screen.
evals.expected_output: The controller does not read the pane: it tells the user to open the Herdr pane labelled `envoy grok <slug>` and finish the login there, waits for the user, then calls prompt-wait.sh --no-read and runs the READY smoke test.

assertions.text: Never runs herdr agent read or any pane-reading command during onboarding
Tells the user the pane label and waits instead of typing into the pane
Every onboarding prompt-wait.sh call uses --no-read
Records the kind with state.sh set-verified --probe smoke only after the smoke exits 0

evals.prompt: (after a context compaction in the middle of a run) continue the envoy run
evals.expected_output: The controller recovers the run folder (the path new-run.sh printed, or the newest .envoy/runs folder whose controller.pane is this pane and status is not cleaned), reads run-state.sh get status and get round, and resumes from the matching step without resending a prompt that is still outstanding.

assertions.text: Reads run.json through run-state.sh get status and get round before any other action
Does not create a new run or reopen panes that run.json records as open
Waits for an outstanding prompt with prompt-wait.sh without --text
